title: Server Infrastructure & UI
summary: This module defines the core server operations, including process management, API endpoints for chat and data retrieval, authentication, and integration with the Windows system tray for desktop application control.

nodes.label: Start Server Application
nodes.title: Run Server Command
nodes.description: Initializes the server environment, including keypair setup and network listening, then delegates to the core server to begin processing requests.

nodes.label: Manage Server Process Lifecycle
nodes.title: Server Process Manager
nodes.description: Manages the main server process, handling startup, graceful shutdowns, restarts, PID file management, and resolving port conflicts by reaping other server instances.

nodes.label: Handle Chat API Requests
nodes.title: Chat API Handler
nodes.description: Processes real-time chat requests from the UI, managing chat history, interacting with the model for generation and pulling, and executing integrated tools like web search. Streams responses back to the client.

nodes.label: Retrieve Chat History
nodes.title: Get Chat API Handler
nodes.description: Retrieves and formats specific chat conversations from the persistent data store, including messages and reconstructed browser state, for display in the user interface.

nodes.label: Authenticate API Requests
nodes.title: Authentication Middleware
nodes.description: Enforces authentication policies for incoming API requests, verifying client tokens and content types to ensure secure access to server functionalities.

nodes.label: Manage Application Settings
nodes.title: Settings Manager
nodes.description: Handles the persistence and retrieval of application settings, such as auto-update preferences, and can trigger actions based on these settings.

nodes.label: Process Windows Tray Events
nodes.title: Windows Tray Event Handler
nodes.description: Manages interactions with the Windows system tray icon, processing user commands like opening the UI, accessing settings, or initiating updates, and handles inter-process communication.

nodes.label: External HTTP Client
nodes.title: HTTP Client
nodes.description: Represents any external client application or browser that communicates with the server via HTTP requests.

nodes.label: Model Inference Engine
nodes.title: Model Inference
nodes.description: The backend system responsible for executing AI model operations, including chat completions, model pulling, and providing model details.

nodes.label: Persistent Data Store
nodes.title: Data Store
nodes.description: A persistent storage mechanism used to save and retrieve application data, such as chat histories, user settings, and model metadata.

nodes.label: Application Updater Service
nodes.title: Updater Service
nodes.description: A dedicated service that manages the application's update process, checking for new versions, downloading updates, and applying them.

groups.label: Server Core
groups.title: Core Server Operations
groups.description: Components responsible for starting, managing, and maintaining the server's operational lifecycle.

groups.label: API Endpoints
groups.title: User Interface API
groups.description: Handlers for processing user-facing API requests, primarily for chat interactions and retrieving chat history.

groups.label: Security & Configuration
groups.title: Authentication and Settings
groups.description: Components managing secure access to the server and handling application-wide configuration settings.

groups.label: Desktop Integration
groups.title: Windows Tray Interface
groups.description: Handles system-level interactions for the desktop application, specifically through the Windows system tray icon.
